properties.rectification: De-noise low-polygon terrain mesh; resolve baked shadow artifacts across Badenoch Strath; erect crisp multi-tier architectural farmstead massing at the valley floor; de-warp scree slopes and heather moorland flanks of the Monadhliath / Cairngorms transition.

properties.bedrock: Grampian Group Neoproterozoic Dalradian metasediments, predominantly quartzites, semipelites, and micaceous psammites interspersed with Caledonian granitic intrusions
properties.stratigraphy: Glacial till and boulder clay mantle topped by deep periglacial scree on upper mountain slopes; glaciofluvial outwash sands, gravelly alluvial braids, and acidic ombrotrophic peat within the Spey valley bottom
properties.soil_profile: Peaty podzols and gleys in low drainage zones transitioning to alpine raw soils and skeletal leptosols across the upper fellfield
properties.hydrology: Catchment drainage funneling toward the River Spey floodplain; surface cut by peat runnels, bog hollows, and seasonal snowmelt gullies

properties.typology: Highland agricultural steadings, steading clusters, and rural estate ancillary outbuildings

structures.facade: Roughcast lime-harled rubblestone with exposed granite ashlar dressings
structures.roof: Steeply pitched Ballachulish grey-blue slate with stone gable copings and dual chimney stacks

structures.facade: Dry-stone and lime-mortared field granite rubble
structures.roof: Weathered corrugated tin and dark bitumen sheeting over heavy timber rafters

structures.facade: Treated vertical larch boarding weathered to silver-grey

civil_infrastructure.tracks: Crushed granite aggregate access track with packed soil margins and drainage ditches
civil_infrastructure.boundaries: Drystone dykes (consumption walls) and post-and-wire deer fencing

properties.biome: Scottish Highland Moorland and Montane Scrub Transition
flora: Juncus effusus (soft rush) in waterlogged marsh flats
Scots pine (Pinus sylvestris) remnants and shelterbelt lodgepole pine/sitka spruce stands
Dwarf willow and lichen-encrusted quartzite fellfields on high ridges

properties.lighting_conditions: Diffused high-latitude Scottish daylight with clear intervals; crisp mountain atmosphere; soft natural shadow casting across the valley floor devoid of digital meshing artifacts
properties.optical_artifacts: Natural telephoto field compression; crisp rendering of heather mosaic and distant montane ridge contours
